title: Definition
text: $$\cos(-\pi/2)$$ is the $$x-$$ coordinate of the point on the circle that lies on the negative vertical axis

title: Coordinate
text: The x-coordinate of the point on the unit circle with angle $$\frac{-\pi}{2}$$ is $$0$$.\n##figure1.gif##

figureAlts.figure1.gif: Diagram of the coordinate (cosine of negative pi over 2, sine of negative pi over 2) on the unit circle on the negative vertical axis.
